properties.description:
Identifies PQC Proxy instances experiencing elevated upstream connection failures when
forwarding requests to backend services. This may indicate the backend is down, overloaded,
or unreachable. While the PQC Proxy TLS termination is functioning correctly, clients will
receive 502/504 errors until the backend recovers.
properties.name: Upstream backend connection failures on PQC Proxy
properties.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventType == "upstream_error"
| summarize ErrorCount = count(), Errors = make_set(ErrorMessage, 5) by ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId, UpstreamTarget
| where ErrorCount > 5
| project ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId, UpstreamTarget, ErrorCount, Errors
| order by ErrorCount desc
